title: Axisymmetric setup
interactive: /define/models/axisymmetric? → Enable/disable axisymmetric model? (internal tree; not observed in the live menu)
notes: The dimensionality is set when starting Fluent (2ddp/3ddp); the axisymmetric? command is registered in the internal tree but hidden in the observed configurations. The `axis` zone type is in the zone-type list (03_BC §3). The chain is not verified.
